scenicChapters.title: Bulgaria Shipka Pass Road
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 7.1%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter — first and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Bulgaria Shipka Pass Road
scenicChapters.narrative: 1190 m come off over 2 km at around 119.0%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

bulgaria-shipka-pass-road.story: A 67 km one-way ride from near Gabrovo, about 1 h 10 of riding. The stops in between: Shipka Pass and Shipka Memorial. The highest point is about 1,200 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
